# Surface Studio

> Surface Studio is a PU paint and polish studio in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It finishes kitchen shutters, wardrobes, doors, furniture and wall panels using premium wood coatings from Sirca, ICA and Axalta, in sheens from dead matt (~5 gloss) to mirror-polished polyester.

## Services
- PU Paint: pigmented 2K polyurethane in any shade, matt to gloss
- PU Polish: clear PU sealer and topcoat on veneer and solid wood
- Polyester high gloss / piano finish
- Water-based, low-VOC finishes (ICA Acquabella and 2K water-based systems)
- Metallic and special effects (copper, bronze, corten, pearl, marble, patina, antique)
- Modular panel finishing from factory cutlists, barcode-tracked, delivered in batches
- Shade matching to RAL, NCS or a physical sample

## PU facts
- PU (polyurethane) is a two-component coating sprayed in thin layers that cures into a tough, smooth matt or gloss film
- PU paint is pigmented (solid colour); PU polish is clear, over wood or veneer
- Can be applied to MDF, HDHMR, solid wood, veneer, plywood, WPC, laminate (with adhesion primer), metal and glass
- PU painted shutter layers: board, sanding and edge sealing, PU sealer/primer, colour coats, finish coat
- PU polish layers: wood or veneer core, sanding, filling, two coats of PU sealer, clear topcoat
- Compared with Duco and melamine, PU is more durable, holds gloss longer and resists yellowing and cracking
- Water-based PU: low VOC, low odour, faster drying; solvent-based PU: toughest film, longer cure
- Care: microfibre cloth and mild soap; avoid abrasives, harsh chemicals and standing water

## Process
1. Surface preparation  2. Sealer and primer  3. Precision coating  4. Controlled curing  5. Final inspection and dispatch
